root_cause.text: In DecodeQ931(), after reading a 16-bit length and decrementing it by 1 to skip the protocol discriminator byte, there is no validation that the resulting length is positive. When the encoded length is zero, the decrement wraps to -1, which is then interpreted as a large unsigned value by DecodeH323_UserInformation(), causing an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "If the encoded length is 0, the decrement wraps to -1, which is then passed as a large value to the decoder, leading to an out-of-bounds read." The patch adds a check `if (len <= 0) break;` to prevent this.
